reasons.plausibility: This is a well-established tribo-corrosion mechanism in multi-component alloys, supported by prior knowledge of passive film formation and mechanical disruption.
reasons.testability: The proposed three-way comparison (wear-only, corrosion-only, and tribo-corrosion) with quantifiable outcomes is straightforward to implement and would decisively prove or disprove the synergy hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses an important gap in understanding the coupled degradation mechanisms in high-entropy alloys and provides a clear path for further research.
